scientific_integrity: All 512 gauge classes are evaluated with integer arithmetic by two independent algorithms. Full 24-edge multiplicities follow from a proved 15-dimensional cut-space gauge reduction; the projection norm follows from an exact second 512-point transform.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact finite computation for the open 4-by-4 grid only. The full Kasteleyn determinant is classical prior theory, and historical signed-weight tables may be unindexed; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact Walsh cancellation and sharp range-projection norm for the \(4\times4\) domino square
